name: commune
description: Open source community platform built on the MERN stack

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @commune/api" "npm run dev -w @commune/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @commune/api && npm run build -w @commune/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @commune/shared && npm run typecheck -w @commune/api && npm run typecheck -w @commune/web
